items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The inline AniBT loading mark: an <output role=status> with a spinning glyph that follows the surrounding ink.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: AniBT 「贴纸手账」 button: candy primary with gloss and a ✦ on hover, raised secondary, quiet ghost, red danger, link and field paints on shadcn's variant and size names, with a non-resizing loading state.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: AniBT tags (neutral, resolution, language, status words), die-cut stickers (paper, candy, water), counts, plus StatusBadge (dot + word) and StatusDot.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: AniBT panel: paper with a 1px edge and the panel shadow (or a flat well), A's 16/12 box with a compact density, and a stitched header or footer.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: AniBT 32px text field: paper under a 1px input ring, pink on hover, a 1.5px ring edge with the pink halo on focus, red when invalid, a sunk well when read-only or disabled.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: AniBT multi-line field: the input's material and states, growing with its content from two lines.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: AniBT field label: 13/600 in ink2 above its control; a disabled control greys it instead of fading it.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: AniBT form grammar on shadcn's field names: label above the control, tags and meta on the label row, a hint or an error under it, choice rows and cards, container-query field rows and stitched field-group cards.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: AniBT select: a field-material trigger and a floating A panel whose chosen row carries the pink label and tick.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: AniBT candy checkbox: an 18px box that turns candy with a white tick that pops in; indeterminate shows a dash.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: AniBT candy switch: a 36x20 sunk track that turns candy, with a white knob that springs across; a 28x16 small size.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: AniBT candy radio: 18px paper discs; the chosen one is candy with a white dot.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: AniBT segmented track: a sunk well of 24px choices where the chosen one is a white sticker thumb with a pink glyph, with radio semantics and an optional label.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: AniBT toggle group: the segmented track with sticker thumbs, or a row of 28px filter chips that turn pink and show a tick when pressed.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: AniBT tabs: 32px tabs over a stitched line; the current tab wears the tilted washi tape, the site's one "you are here" mark.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: AniBT search box: an input with the magnifier, a clear key that keeps focus, a key-cap shortcut hint and the phone keyboard's search key.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: AniBT password field: an input with a named show / hide key that reports its state.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: AniBT key cap: a sunk 20px cap with a 1px floor in the round face, and KbdGroup for a chord.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: AniBT die-cut avatar: the white sticker rim and shadow, round for people and rounded-square for groups, initials in the round face on the pink wash, plus shadcn's AvatarBadge, AvatarGroup and AvatarGroupCount.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: entity-avatar
items.title: Entity Avatar
items.description: One picture of a thing — a subtitle group's logo or a user's portrait — with the one fallback rule: the real image, else script-aware initials in the same die-cut sticker.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: AniBT loading placeholder: one step deeper than a field, radius 10, a slow pulse and nothing else; box, line, pill and circle shapes.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: AniBT progress bar: a sunk track with a glossy water (in progress), candy (your goal) or mint (done) fill, an indeterminate slide, and Base UI's label / value row.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: AniBT pager: quiet 32px cells in the round face, the current page washed pink with a ring, 44px touch targets, shadcn's parts with Chinese defaults, and a Pager that draws the whole row from page and pageCount.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: AniBT empty state: a framed well, or A's tilted paper note with your picture peeking over its edge between twinkling sparkles; icon, image and peek media slots.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: AniBT hint bubble: the dark tip (light in 夜樱) with a tail in its own colour, Radix behaviour, a self-providing root, and Base UI's render / delay props for shadcn's base-* sidebar.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: AniBT rule: the dashed stitch (horizontal or vertical) or the solid 1px edge, with Radix and Base UI orientation attributes.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: AniBT notice: a note on the state's wash (info blue, success mint, warning amber, destructive red) with the icon in the state's ink, or the inline row form with a leading dot; AlertAction for a retry.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: AniBT folding sections: stitched rows or separate wells, 14/700 triggers that turn pink, a chevron that flips pink when open; single and collapsible by default.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: AniBT trail: 13px muted steps, links that turn pink, the current page in ink, small chevrons; asChild or Base UI render for router links.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: AniBT data table on a real <table>: 36px head of muted labels, 48px rows parted by the stitch, pink-washed selected rows, numeric cells in the round face, an optional sticky head and a two-line identity cell.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: AniBT section head in one compact row: a tilted sticker mark, the 20/800 title, a figure in the round face, an ellipsised description and the page's tool group.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: poster-card
items.title: Poster Card
items.description: AniBT collectible poster card: a 2:3 cover in a glossy sleeve with a sheen on hover, a tilted airtime sticker, corner badges and a subscribe key; fixed height with a two-line title; srcSet / sizes for sharp covers; PosterGrid, rating, status and skeleton.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: release-row
items.title: Release Row
items.description: AniBT release row: a die-cut cover, the full title over the publisher, episode and three coloured tags, then size, swarm and age columns and always-visible icon squares; wide, stacked and compact forms by container width.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>
